title: Galaxy on Fire 2 Remake mission (.gof2mission)
description: events/<name>.gof2mission in a mod: a story mission, bar mission or event as a tree of steps (Modding/README.md "Missions made in the Mod Builder"). The file name is its name. Files from before the rename (.gof2quest, format "gof2quest") are read too.

title.description: the title (story and bar missions need one)

kind.description: quest: a story mission, starts by itself when startsWhen holds; mission: a bar mission offered in the Space Lounges; event: started by /event or another's startevent step

startsWhen.description: a story mission's start: "" at once, "never" only by a startquest step, else a condition (visited(78), quest(other) == 2, campaign >= 20...); a bar mission (single player): no bar offers it until it holds

once.description: a bar mission (single player): once completed, no bar offers it again in this game (quest(name) then reads 2)

repeat.description: a story mission that comes again: this many minutes of playing time after it was done, as soon as its startsWhen holds then (add a chance to it, random(1, 300) == 1, for a random moment; 0 / left out: once)

offer.description: a bar mission: what the visitor says

client.description: a bar mission's client: a story character, "mod_id:character", "vossk K'ekki"; empty: someone of the station's race

stations.description: a bar mission is offered at (empty: everywhere)

chance.description: a bar mission: the percentage of its stations' bars offering it (default 35; each station decides for 30 minutes and drops it for 30 once taken; 100: always)

takers.description: a bar mission: who can take it: universe (default) one squad at a time anywhere, offered nowhere meanwhile; station: one per station, other stations still offer it; any: any number of squads, at one station too

variables.description: numbers the mission keeps; {name} in a text shows one

autoComplete.description: completes after its last step when no complete / fail ended it

loose.description: the builder's graph: chains wired to nothing (they don't run)

values.description: value nodes, wired into fields as { "$value": id }
